name: kr-card-benefits-lab
description: 카드사 공식 공개 피드 기반 한국 신용·체크카드 혜택 데이터셋 및 정적 리서치 대시보드

scripts.serve: node --run build && node -e "import('node:http').then(async({default:h})=>{const{readFile}=await import('node:fs/promises');const p=await import('node:path');h.createServer(async(q,s)=>{try{const f=p.join('dist',q.url==='/'?'index.html':q.url.split('?')[0]);const b=await readFile(f);const t={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8'}[p.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream';s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':t});s.end(b)}catch{s.writeHead(404).end('not found')}}).listen(8787,()=>console.log('http://localhost:8787'))})"
